drills.name: Superman Glide
drills.cue: Relax the head, widen the arms, and let the water support you.
drills.progression: Glide farther with the same push and no extra effort.

drills.name: Superman Flutter
drills.cue: Use a quiet, compact kick while keeping the head weightless.
drills.progression: Reduce kick amplitude without losing balance.

drills.name: Torpedo
drills.cue: Keep the body long with arms relaxed at your sides.
drills.progression: Hold a straighter bodyline with less kicking.

drills.name: Superman to Skate
drills.cue: Rotate as one unit and arrive in a stable, long skate.
drills.progression: Make the transition quieter and more balanced.

drills.name: Skating
drills.cue: Lead hand on its track, head aligned, shoulder and hip connected.
drills.progression: Maintain alignment with a smaller supporting kick.

drills.name: Breathe in Skate
drills.cue: Let the chin follow the shoulder; keep one goggle in the water.
drills.progression: Return to skate without changing the lead-hand track.

drills.name: Leaning Skate
drills.cue: Let the weight of the recovering arm move the body forward.
drills.progression: Create forward travel from weight shift, not a hard pull.

drills.name: Skate–Stroke–Skate
drills.cue: Take three to five quiet strokes between balanced skate positions.
drills.progression: Make every whole stroke reproduce your skate alignment.

drills.name: SpearSkate
drills.cue: Slide the recovery hand under water onto a shoulder-width track.
drills.progression: Spear cleanly without disturbing the balanced bodyline.

drills.name: Two-Pause SpearSwitch
drills.cue: Pause at the goggles, then pause again in the new skate.
drills.progression: Hit the same alignment on both sides.

drills.name: One-Pause SpearSwitch
drills.cue: Keep the lead hand patient until the spearing hand reaches its target.
drills.progression: Remove one pause without rushing the switch.

drills.name: Rhythmic SpearSwitch
drills.cue: Connect hip drive and spear in an unbroken, relaxed rhythm.
drills.progression: Hold rhythm while reducing strokes per length.

drills.name: ZenSkate / SwingSkate
drills.cue: Swing the relaxed recovery arm forward, out rather than up.
drills.progression: Keep the opposite side long while the arm recovers.

drills.name: ZenSwitch / SwingSwitch
drills.cue: Use the falling recovery arm to trigger a clean weight shift.
drills.progression: Move from interrupted to continuous switches.

drills.name: Rag Doll Recovery
drills.cue: Let the forearm and hand hang completely loose from the elbow.
drills.progression: Preserve relaxation at normal swimming tempo.

drills.name: Ear Hops
drills.cue: Move the relaxed hand past the ear while the elbow leads.
drills.progression: Keep the path compact without shoulder tension.

drills.name: Elbow Circles
drills.cue: Lead recovery with a smooth elbow circle and loose hand.
drills.progression: Blend the circle into whole stroke without a pause.

drills.name: Draw a Line
drills.cue: Trace a direct line forward on a shoulder-width track.
drills.progression: Keep entry direction precise as tempo rises.

drills.name: Mail Slot Entry
drills.cue: Slip hand and forearm quietly through one clean opening.
drills.progression: Eliminate splash and bubbles at entry.

drills.name: Swim and Nod
drills.cue: Practice the start of the breath while keeping the head low.
drills.progression: Make the nod part of body roll rather than a separate lift.

drills.name: Skate–Breathe–Skate
drills.cue: Rotate to air and return to the identical skate position.
drills.progression: Breathe with one goggle submerged and no lead-arm collapse.

drills.name: Two-Beat Kick Timing
drills.cue: Match each toe flick to the opposite hand entering its track.
drills.progression: Keep timing crisp while the legs remain quiet.

drills.name: Tempo Trainer Pyramid
drills.cue: Change tempo in small steps while protecting stroke length.
drills.progression: Find the fastest sustainable tempo before SPL rises.

drills.name: SPL Golf
drills.cue: Add seconds and strokes; seek the lowest repeatable total.
drills.progression: Improve the score without straining or gliding excessively.

drills.name: Whole Stroke — One Focal Point
drills.cue: Choose one cue and keep attention on it for the entire repeat.
drills.progression: Extend distance before attention or form breaks.

presets.name: Advanced Efficiency
presets.description: Balance calibration, switch timing, then efficient whole stroke.

presets.name: Quiet Recovery & Entry
presets.description: Relax the recovery and preserve clean tracks at speed.

presets.name: Seamless Breathing
presets.description: Build a low, stable breath into uninterrupted freestyle.

presets.name: Tempo & Stroke Length
presets.description: Protect streamline and SPL as swimming tempo increases.
